title: ANSWER LINE UNDER YOUR FEET
why: his ask 10-27 ~21:40: the hud messaging is a clusterfuck, make it AAA (report reports/Player alerts and HUD messaging.md, job 7). The answer to a try that did not work (health full, no ammo, locked) is one small line about 70 px under the character, at least 20 px, for 2 s, once per press, and no longer a line in the left feed. There is no soft no sound in the game, so it stays silent. Backpack full stays in the pickup stack and contract item nearby stays in the feed, exactly as before; looting is untouched.
now: when something you try does not work, the answer shows small under your feet for 2 s
